summary: NexPoint Capital, Inc. filed an 8-K covering two routine items: the board declared a $0.09 per share cash distribution payable July 13, 2026 to holders of record June 30, 2026 as an ordinary dividend under Item 2.02; and under Item 8.01 the board determined a June 30, 2026 NAV of $4.36 per share, which serves as the price floor for shares issued under the distribution reinvestment plan per Rule 2a-5. No strategic transaction, merger, tender offer, or special situation is announced. This is a routine dividend and NAV disclosure for a closed-end fund.
